reasons_not_assessed: Only n = 1 post-invasion March–August season (2022) exists, which cannot support variance estimation or a hypothesis test for a war-period effect.
Daily retrievals exhibit positive serial correlation (see daily_autocorrelation_diagnostics), so ordinary independent-observation tests on correlated daily rows would understate standard errors.
April 2022 has low coverage (8/30 valid days, 26.67%), introducing potential clear-sky sampling bias.
No matched reference/comparator region series or meteorological covariates (wind speed, mixing height, cloud bias) are included in this single-region export.

pre_invasion.label: Pre-invasion baseline period (March 2015 – February 2022)
pre_invasion.primary_method: Month-Fixed-Effects OLS with Newey-West HAC standard errors

nonparametric_sensitivity.method: Within-month Seasonal Theil-Sen + Hamed-Rao (1998) modified Mann-Kendall on deseasonalized monthly anomalies

assumptions_and_caveats: Treats missing-day-adjusted monthly means as equal-precision observations despite varying monthly coverage (some <50%).
Accounts for annual cycle via 12 monthly fixed intercepts and short-range serial correlation via Newey-West HAC (lags <= 6 months).
A monotonic linear rate over 2015–2022 blends pre-war variability, 2020 COVID-19 changes, and post-February 2022 disruption and should not be mistaken for a step-change war effect.

limitations: Classified as related_comparison to Ialongo et al. (2023) OMI component; coarser 0.25-degree OMNO2d grid and unresolved paper mask/screening details preclude claiming exact replication.
Tropospheric vertical column NO2 (molecules/cm^2) measures lower-atmosphere column density, not surface air-quality concentration or personal exposure.
April 2022 contains only 8 valid observations out of 30 days (26.67% coverage, below the 50% proposed project threshold), requiring explicit coverage sensitivity checks.

Observed March–August NO2 was already low in 2020 (2.115e15) and especially 2021 (1.819e15, leaving 2022 only -6.65% below 2021 under valid-day weighting), so raw 2022 drops cannot be attributed causally to war without comparator areas and weather covariates.

No validated reference/comparator regions are yet included in this single-region export; candidate reference areas still need to be formally selected, justified in docs/study-spec.md, and checked for pre-2022 trajectory alignment.
